_about: Z31: zone class-named functions no document cited (guild rename / retype commit, chat-spam block save, chat colour save). Offsets are payload offsets (after the 2-byte opcode). Layouts read in the 2016 zone code (zone-pdb export); names from the 2016 zone PDB. See docs/pseudocode/zone/Z31-class-remainder.md.

0x74b1.name: NC_GUILD_WORLD_RENAME_CMD
0x74b1.basis: zone ShinePlayer::so_ply_GuildReNameItemUseSuccess FUN_00473ea0 (vt 0x888, after the Item DB confirmed the rename item); receiver wm FUN_0042e520 (W03 §9.3)
0x74b1.notes: 0x16 bytes payload (0x18 with opcode); sent only when the ring entry still belongs to the player; followed by 0x74AD {0x1A40} to the client

0x74b9.name: NC_GUILD_WORLD_RETYPE_CMD
0x74b9.notes: 7 bytes payload (9 with opcode); followed by 0x74B5 {0x1A58} to the client

0x4022.name: NC_CHARSAVE_SET_CHAT_BLOCK_SPAMER_DB_CMD
0x4022.basis: zone ShinePlayer::so_SpamSendDataToCharDB FUN_00562990 (vt 0xab8, full save ws_save2DB); receiver character FUN_00423420 (D02)
fields: seconds of chat block left (min 1 while blocked), 0 = not blocked
BlockTime != 0: probation seconds after the block; BlockTime == 0: unix time the probation ends, 0 = none
0x4022.notes: 0xC bytes payload, no header; a zero state is sent once after a non-zero one (sp_SpamerInfoSaveChack), otherwise skipped

0x4021.name: NC_CHARSAVE_SET_CHAT_BLOCK_SPAMER_WM_CMD
0x4021.basis: zone ShinePlayer::sp_SpamSendDataToWM FUN_00562bc0 (from ws_save2worldmanager); receiver wm FUN_0042c2a0 (W05)
0x4021.notes: 0xE bytes payload; always sent; the WM returns the values in 0x10CB at the next map login

0x4032.name: NC_CHARSAVE_2WLDMAN_CHAT_COLOR_CMD
0x4032.basis: zone ShinePlayer::sp_ChatColor_Save2World FUN_00563c70 (from ws_save2worldmanager); receiver wm FUN_0042ccc0 (W05)

0x3014.name: NC_ITEM_SOMEONEPICK_CMD
0x3014.basis: zone ShinePlayer::sp_Send_NC_ITEM_SOMEONEPICK_CMD FUN_0052f0e0 (from so_ply_PickupItem FUN_0052faf0) via AxialListPacketBroadcast4ItemPickUp FUN_00428f40; client FUN_004abc20
0x3014.notes: 0x1A bytes payload (0x1C with opcode); to every player in sight in a game mode, the picker excluded; the client prints 'expedition group has received an item' only for a member of its party

0x3049.name: NC_ITEM_EQUIP_BELONGED_CANCEL_USE_ACK
0x3049.basis: zone sp_NC_ITEM_EQUIP_BELONGED_CANCEL_USE_REQ FUN_0051b9a0 (refusals); success from the DB answer 0x34A7 (Z05 §5.3); client FUN_004b3940
fields: 0x2880 ok; 0x2882 mode, 0x2885 fear, 0x2886 captivated, 0x2883 no field, 0x2884 lock busy, 0x2887 NPC menu / storage open, 0x2888 bound cell missing, 0x288a bound item unknown, 0x288c not PutOnBelonged, 0x288d not bound, 0x2889 cancel cell missing, 0x288b cancel item unknown / lot < 1, 0x288e not ITEMFUNC_PUTON_CLEAR, 0x288f grade differs (Z31 §11.4)
0x3049.notes: client shows FUN_00416430(nError) for every code but 0x2880; 0x2883 / 0x2886 / 0x2888 / 0x2889 have no text (Z31-B27)

0x203d.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCE_FOLDTENT_CMD
0x203d.basis: zone so_ply_ReinforceFoldtent FUN_0055ae50 via so_SendProtocol(8, 0x3d) FUN_0054ef70; client FUN_004c4bc0 (no payload read)
0x203d.notes: header only (2 bytes); name pdb2017; sent when the server folds the player's tent before a link / teleport (Z31 §11.3)
